scope.priority: OLE2 and OOXML remain the active priority; ODF deferred until that goal completes; iWork excluded.

hypothesis.statement: CFB directory-entry name comparison computes the [MS-CFB] 2.6.4 simple uppercase mapping with char::to_uppercase, which constructs a Unicode case-mapping iterator per scalar. Deterministic branch-simulation attributed 205,732 of 660,113 baseline conditional branch misses in one OLE2 edit/save child to <core::char::ToUppercase as Iterator>::next.
hypothesis.mechanism: No ASCII scalar has a multi-character uppercase mapping and its single-character mapping is the ASCII one, so an ASCII branch returns exactly the same scalar without touching the Unicode tables. CFB stream and path names are ASCII in practice.
hypothesis.equivalence: Proven exhaustively over the entire Unicode scalar range by uppercase_matches_unicode_mapping_for_every_char in both owners, not sampled.
hypothesis.predicted_effect: Lower instruction count and lower branch-miss count in CFB directory-name construction and comparison; measurable on OLE2 edit/save workloads that build or search directory trees.

acceptance.primary_gate: exhaustive differential equality over every Unicode scalar, plus unchanged comparison keys, refusals and ordering.
acceptance.secondary_gate: deterministic Callgrind Ir and conditional-branch-miss counts must both fall for the profiled OLE2 edit/save child.
acceptance.latency_gate: paired A/B p50 must improve in both directions for the profiled OLE2 cases; every case with adverse movement above 5% in both directions is reported.
acceptance.regression_context: change 0558 left a reproducible layout-induced regression on ole_common_one_edit_save; this change is also measured against that state and against the pre-0558 baseline.

cpu.aslr: disabled with setarch -R for the three-stage comparison; enabled for the ABBA legs
